senses.gloss:
उच् उच्, i. 4, Par. To like, to be accustomed to.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. उचित,
 1. Used, Rām. 4, 8, 57.
 2. Accustomed to (with the gen.), Nal. 23, 22.
 3. Suitable, proper, Pañc. 176, 1; [] Rājat. 5, 184; Rām. 1, 44, 56.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. सम् सम्, in the ptcple. of the pf. pass. समुचित, Used to, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 16.
